basics.name: Martin Truong
basics.label: Full Stack Software Engineer
basics.summary: A full stack software engineer with over 2.5 years of professional experience. Passionate about turning ideas into reliable, easy-to-use products. Always looking for the next problem worth solving.

education.area: Bachelor of Science (Honours) - Computer Science, Data Science specialization

work.name: K & A Consultants Limited
work.summary: Developed and launched a full-stack meeting scheduling platform with Next.js and Typescript.
responsibilities: Built a landing page, events listings catalog, meeting-booking workflow, and an administrative dashboard with React and Tailwind CSS.
Used Next.js server actions and Prisma to build an API layer with Postgres CRUD operations.
Implemented Google Calendar API integration to automatically generate calendar events after successful bookings.
achievements: Converted designer-provided Canva mockups into responsive interfaces, delivering 10 core pages across desktop and mobile layouts.
Integrated stored user and event data to reliably manage over 25 meetings per week.
Eliminated manual calendar entry and reduced scheduling overhead by 80%.

work.name: Ontario Tech University
work.summary: Led 12 weekly lab sessions for 35 first-year students in an introductory Python course.
responsibilities: Explained programming fundamentals and guided students through hands-on coding exercises.
Provided weekly office hours and one-on-one support, helping students troubleshoot programming and version control challenges.
Identified syntax, logic, and testing issues in assignment and exam submissions.
achievements: Helped students understand course concepts and develop structured problem-solving approaches.
Graded and tested over 300 submissions in total; delivered detailed feedback for each submission within 48 hours.

work.name: Vialab
work.summary: Modernized existing layouts, resolving UI/UX bugs, and streamlined content workflows within the lab's WordPress website. Also assisted in a research project.
responsibilities: Redesigned multiple reusable components and page layouts, improving usability and maintaining consistent branding.
Investigated and resolved 15 UI/UX defects using WordPress CMS tools.
Standardized content publishing workflows and collaborated with researchers to implement structured, consistent updates for newly published articles.
Wrote Python scripts with Pandas to clean and tabulate data from a CSV containing survey responses.
achievements: Created a more intuitive and professional online experience that effectively showcased the work of 12 researchers and 10 monthly recurring content updates.
Validated fixes on desktop and mobile breakpoints to improve consistency across user-facing and admin site sections.
Contributed to a research project analyzing Ontario Tech students' usage of language learning apps when learning Italian.

work.name: Dragon Lubes
work.summary: Independently designed, built, and deployed a full-stack e-commerce storefront for a local automotive chemical distributor.
responsibilities: Designed and developed new layouts for the landing page, catalog, and product pages in Next.js with React and Tailwind CSS.
Used TypeScript, React Query, and GraphQL for client-side data fetching through Shopify's Storefront API.
achievements: Successfully replaced the store's Google Sites presence with a production platform hosted on Vercel.
Integrated Shopify product and cart data to implement shopping cart functionality and checkout flows on product pages.
Supported approximately $30k in online sales during Q4 2022.

Cohere powered chatbot provides instant responses to user queries
Frontend built with Streamlit, designed to be lightweight and accessible

projects.name: Iris
projects.description: A full-stack web application that allows for live translation of recorded audio transcriptions with uses in a wide variety of settings. Developed at QHacks 2022.

🏆 Won 4th place out of 75+ teams and two awards
